lettuce_sync.signature: List<Long> spexpire(K key, long milliseconds, V... members)

params.name: key
params.description: the key of the set, must not be null.

params.name: milliseconds
params.description: the time to live in milliseconds, must not be negative.

params.name: members
params.description: the members to set the time to live for, must not be null or empty.

returns.description: a list with one Long per member, in the order of members: 2 if the member was deleted because the expiration is in the past; 1 if the expiration was set or updated; 0 if a NX, XX, GT or LT condition was not met; -2 if the member does not exist (a logically expired member does not exist) or key does not exist.
